analysis.session_summary: The window was driven by the US employment beat: Non-Farm Employment Change printed 162K vs 55K forecast, lifting USD against most majors (DXY +0.146%) and sending EUR/USD down 15.2 pips. JPY was the strongest currency (+0.363% vs majors), while NZD (-0.237%) and CAD (-0.193%) lagged on soft data and Trump trade rhetoric. A Canada employment miss (-41.7K vs 15.1K forecast) and Trump Canada dollar imbalance comments amplified CAD weakness. Oil rebounded (Brent +1.489%) but equity/VIX tone stayed cautious.
